## About Our Platform

Welcome to our Data Analytics Platform. This platform provides comprehensive tools and resources for data analysis, visualization, and reporting. Our mission is to empower teams with accessible, powerful analytics capabilities that drive informed decision-making.

We offer a range of features including interactive dashboards, geospatial analysis, and customizable reporting tools designed to meet the diverse needs of modern data-driven organizations.

## Platform Overview

Below is an overview of our platform capabilities and supported features:

```{r}
#| warning: false
library(dplyr)
library(DT)

# Create sample data about platform features
platform_data <- data.frame(
  Feature = c("Interactive Dashboards", "Data Visualization", "Geospatial Analysis",
              "Statistical Analysis", "Custom Reports", "Real-time Data",
              "API Integration", "Export Capabilities", "User Management", "Version Control"),
  Category = c("Visualization", "Visualization", "Mapping", "Analytics",
               "Reporting", "Data", "Integration", "Export", "Admin", "Admin"),
  Status = c("Active", "Active", "Active", "Active", "Active",
             "Beta", "Active", "Active", "Active", "Planned"),
  Users = c(245, 312, 89, 178, 156, 45, 67, 289, 34, 12),
  Last_Updated = c("2024-01-08", "2024-01-09", "2024-01-07", "2024-01-08",
                   "2024-01-06", "2024-01-09", "2024-01-05", "2024-01-09",
                   "2024-01-04", "2024-01-03")
) %>%
  arrange(desc(Users)) %>%
  mutate(
    Adoption_Rate = round(Users / max(Users) * 100, 1),
    Last_Updated = as.Date(Last_Updated)
  )

# Create interactive table
datatable(platform_data,
          options = list(
            pageLength = 10,
            searching = TRUE,
            ordering = TRUE,
            dom = 'Bfrtip',
            buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel')
          ),
          filter = 'top',
          rownames = FALSE,
          caption = "Platform Features and Usage Statistics") %>%
  formatStyle('Status',
              backgroundColor = styleEqual(
                c('Active', 'Beta', 'Planned'),
                c('#d4edda', '#fff3cd', '#f8d7da')
              ))
```
